incidents.summary: Georgia’s banking regulator confirmed conflict-of-interest breaches involving loans to TBC Bank’s founders, with the bank subsequently agreeing to a penalty and supervisory-board restructuring.

sources.title: Statement of The National Bank of Georgia
sources.quote: Mamuka Khazaradze and Badri Japaridze, violating the legislation regulating conflicts of interests issues, took loans in the amount of USD 16.7 million from the bank via other legal entities

sources.title: Joint Statement
sources.quote: TBC Bank withdraws all court cases against the National Bank of Georgia and will pay approximately GEL 1 million, which was previously requested by the NBG and disclosed by TBC PLC on 9 January 2019.

sources.title: Joint Statement
sources.quote: it will implement a restructuring of its Supervisory Board whereby the founding shareholders will not be represented at the supervisory Board of JSC TBC Bank.

incidents.summary: The National Bank of Georgia fined TBC Bank GEL 928,000 for misrepresenting information during an inspection and breaching customer-identification requirements.

sources.title: The National Bank of Georgia
sources.quote: The monetary fine of 928 000 (nine hundred twenty-eight thousand) GEL was imposed on commercial bank JSC “TBC BANK” (I.N. 204854595)

sources.title: The National Bank of Georgia
sources.quote: For 4 (four) cases for misrepresentation of information/documentation to the National Bank of Georgia in the process of inspection;

sources.title: The National Bank of Georgia
sources.quote: the rule of customer identification is violated towards a high risk client

incidents.summary: The National Bank of Georgia fined TBC Bank GEL 250,000 for suspicious-transaction reporting, customer due-diligence and other compliance failures.

sources.title: The National Bank of Georgia
sources.quote: A monetary fine was imposed on the commercial bank JSC “TBC Bank” (ID No. 204854595) in the amount of GEL 250,000 (two hundred and fifty thousand).

sources.title: The National Bank of Georgia
sources.quote: With respect to 23 (twenty-three) clients, failure to apply risk-appropriate preventive measures;

sources.title: The National Bank of Georgia
sources.quote: For failure to comply within the set deadlines, with 3 (three) written requirements issued as a result of an on-site inspection;

positives: TBC Bank participates in a loan-portfolio decarbonisation project with RINA and the Global Climate Partnership Fund.
The EBRD and Green Climate Fund arranged a US$25 million green-lending package for TBC Bank.
TBC Bank offers paid paternity leave, with documented employee uptake.
TBC Bank introduced mandatory gender-equality training for all employees in early 2023.
